questions.prompt: In the traced request, which step writes the JSONL file before the model sees the request?
options: The SDK server, when it reads the line
The checkpoint policy, on llm/stream before the call
The DeepSeek adapter, after the reply
questions.explanation: session-checkpoint-policy listens on llm/stream and flushes the session before each model call, so the request can be rebuilt after a crash.

questions.prompt: The sdk-minimal profile mounts no approval row. A tool call reaches an ask decision. What happens?
options: The call runs, because nobody refused it
The call is denied, because nobody can answer
questions.explanation: An ask needs a person. With no approval service to answer it, the pipeline fails closed and denies the call.

questions.prompt: How does one layer, such as the compaction plugin, reach the agent loop?
options: Through services and events on the shared context
questions.explanation: Each layer is a plugin. Compaction listens on the agent/pre-step hook, so it changes the loop's behaviour without touching the loop's code.
